meta.title: Find all references counts references for static member and regular member with same name
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#38730 (fix static method reference non-static), bf1ea6508b, 2020-07-09; git tag --contains: first in v4.0-rc / v4.0.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@3.9.10 (2021-06-16, the last 3.9 release; the fix is not on the 3.9 branch) and typescript@4.0.2 (2020-08-20), both behind typescript-language-server@0.4.0 (the latest wrapper release before 4.0.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js (--tsserver-path); the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. The wrapper is installed with the npm dependencies of its release date (install_builds.wrapper_before); it logs no TypeScript version, so the build check verifies that the wrapper's tsserver child runs the pinned tsserver.js.
meta.notes: R3 formulation of the issue's expected result ('There should only be a single reference (itself)'): the static foo has no uses, so every location find-all-references returns for it must be one of its definitions; pre-fix the instance method foo of the base class is returned as well.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

files.note: tab indentation as in the issue; the maintainer's trace was taken on a .js file with the same code

repro.steps: Open index.ts and run find all references on the static foo of class X (line 5, the position the maintainer's trace queries). Reported: two references are returned, the static foo and the instance foo of the base class Y; expected: a single reference (itself). Probe (R3, one session): the references of the static foo must be a subset of its definitions (textDocument/definition at the same position).
